plugin.name: Noise
plugin.description: Perlin/simplex noise for landscapes: terrains with hills, mountains, islands, canyons and dunes (live preview, editable with the Terrain tool), scattering trees, bushes and rocks, roughening groups, a noise material and s3d.noise() for scripts.

terrain.name: Noise terrain
terrain.hint: Pick a landscape or move the sliders – the preview follows. “Create” adds it to the model.
terrain.editing: Changing “{name}” – the preview shows the new version.
terrain.sculptHint: The terrain is a terrain like the Terrain tool’s: select it and start “Terrain” to sculpt it further by hand.

presets.mountainsTitle: Sharp ridges with snow on the peaks
presets.islandTitle: Land that falls into the sea towards the edges

scatter.name: Scattered objects
scatter.hint: Spreads objects – along the selected edges (a path, an avenue), on the selected faces, or over the selected terrain (else the newest one). A noise mask gathers them in clumps; steep slopes and water stay free. All of it lands in one group.
scatter.nothingChosen: Pick at least one kind of object.
scatter.nothing: No place matched – lower the spacing, raise the density or allow steeper slopes.
scatter.noTarget: No terrain to scatter on – select one, create a noise terrain or give an area.
scatter.unknownObject: Unknown object “{name}” – allowed: {allowed} or the name of a component in the model.

target.terrain: On the selected or newest terrain

scatter.title: Scatter

deform.hint: Deforms the selected groups: their faces are split finely, then twisted, tapered or bent along their height and moved in and out by 3D noise – boxes become boulders or twisted towers. On a terrain the noise goes onto its height grid.
deform.noTarget: Select one or more groups first.

script.hint: The plugin adds these functions to s3d:
script.shader: The noise material (Materials panel › texture “Noise”) also works in scripts:
script.open: Open example in the script editor
script.noiseDescription: Seeded simplex noise at a point, −1 … 1: in 2D with x and y, in 3D with z as well. The same point and seed always give the same value; neighbouring points give similar ones.
script.fbmDescription: Several octaves of simplex noise added up (fBm, −1 … 1) or as ridged (sharp crests, 0 … 1) or billow (round bumps, 0 … 1). Octaves, persistence and lacunarity set how much fine detail there is.
script.terrainDescription: A terrain from fractal noise as a group, with grass, earth, rock and snow by height and slope, optional water and terraces. It keeps its settings and its height grid – the Noise panel changes it, the Terrain tool sculpts it.
script.scatterDescription: Places trees, bushes, rocks or components of the model on a terrain (or an area on the ground), gathered by a noise mask, with random size and turn. Returns the group with all of them.
script.deformDescription: Splits the faces of groups finely and moves them along their normals by 3D noise – stones, rough walls, bent shapes. On a terrain it adds the noise to the height grid. Returns the number of groups changed.
script.cellDescription: Cellular (Worley/Voronoi) noise at a point: f1 is the distance to the nearest site, f2 to the second nearest (f2 − f1 is 0 on the borders between cells), id a number 0 … 1 per cell, site the nearest site. One cell ≈ one unit.
script.pavingDescription: Lays stones on the selected faces (any direction – floors and walls) or on an area: Voronoi cells with joints, chamfered tops, varied heights and shades, optional mortar. Returns the group.
script.facadeDescription: Lays windows with frames and sills, balconies, shutters and a ground floor with shop windows and a door on walls: the selected faces, a face, or all walls of a group. The variation per window comes from the seed. Returns the group.
script.cityDescription: A city of streets, blocks and buildings whose heights follow a noise density map (high centre, low edges), with setbacks and roof boxes; the facades use the facade shader. Returns the group. With `on` (a terrain) the city is built on it: it takes the terrain's size, `flatten` eases the slopes, every block becomes a level terrace with retaining walls and the streets follow the ground.
script.treeDescription: Grows a tree as a component and places it: oak, birch, pine or palm, with height, gnarl (bent branches) and crown density; the same settings grow the same tree and reuse its component. Returns the placed tree.
script.erodeDescription: Hydraulic erosion on terrains (noise terrains or ones from the Terrain tool): raindrops dig gullies into the slopes and fill the valleys with sediment, then steep slopes slide a little. Returns how many terrains changed.
script.riverDescription: Digs a river into a terrain (a noise terrain or one from the Terrain tool): the cheapest way through the valleys from `from` to `to` (default: high on the border to its lowest spot), meandering by noise, with a bed that only falls, wider downstream, filled with water. Returns the group with the water.
script.roadDescription: Builds a road or gravel path over a terrain: between `from` and `to` it finds the way below the steepest grade, `along` (or several selected edges) it follows the points. The terrain is cut and filled to an evenly graded bed with banks; asphalt gets a dashed centre line. Returns the group with the road surface.
script.villagesDescription: Builds villages on a terrain (a noise terrain or one from the Terrain tool): sites on gentle, dry ground away from cities, rivers and roads, a main street along the contour with side streets, houses with gable or hip roofs on plinths beside them, and roads between the villages (a minimum spanning tree, gravel or asphalt, or none). Returns the group with the houses.
script.rebuildDescription: Builds a terrain’s recipe again: the heights from the start (the noise terrain’s settings, or the heights before the first step), everything the steps made removed, then every step that is switched on, in order. Sculpting with the Terrain tool since the last time becomes a step of its own. Returns how many steps ran.
script.stepsDescription: The building steps of a terrain, in order: index, kind (erode, river, road, city, villages, scatter, sculpt), whether it is switched on and its seed.
script.editStepDescription: Switches a building step on or off, gives it another seed or removes it – then builds the terrain again. Returns how many steps ran.

paving.hint: Stones from cellular noise (Voronoi): flagstones, cobbles, slabs or a dry wall – each a stone of its own with a chamfer, joints between them, heights and shades varied.
paving.onArea: No face selected: an area of its own beside the model

presets.wallTitle: Long, thick stones – for a wall face

paving.name: Stones
paving.noTarget: Select one or more faces or give an area.
paving.nothing: No stone fits – make the stones smaller or the area bigger.
paving.tooMany: Too many stones (more than {max}) – make them bigger.

facade.title: Facade
facade.hint: Windows with frames and sills, balconies, shutters and a ground floor with shop windows and a door – laid on the selected wall faces or all walls of the selected group. Each window varies by the seed.
facade.onGroup: On all walls of the selected group
facade.noTarget: Select wall faces or a group (e.g. a box).
facade.nothing: No window fits – the walls are too small for the storey height and window size.
facade.name: Facade

city.title: City
city.hint: A grid of streets with pavements, blocks split into plots and a building on each. The heights follow a density map of noise – tall in the middle, low at the edges, where the houses get gable and hip roofs. Some blocks become perimeter blocks round a courtyard, some parks; street trees and road markings finish it off. The facades are drawn by the facade shader, so even large cities stay light.
city.name: City
city.nothing: No building fits – make the blocks or plots bigger.
city.onTerrain: On the selected terrain – the city takes its size, blocks become terraces with retaining walls, streets follow the ground.
city.besideModel: No terrain selected: on flat ground beside the model.

tree.title: Grow a tree
tree.hint: A tree grown from a seed: the trunk forks again and again, every branch bent by noise, leaves in clusters at the tips. Oak, birch, pine and palm – each seed grows another one.

erosion.noTarget: Select a terrain first (a noise terrain or one from the Terrain tool).

routes.noTarget: Make or select a terrain first (a noise terrain or one from the Terrain tool).

river.title: River
river.hint: A river over the selected (or newest) terrain: it keeps to the valleys, meanders by noise, digs a bed that only falls downstream and fills it with water. Without settings it runs from high on the border to the lowest spot of it.
river.name: River

road.title: Road or path
road.hint: A road over the terrain that finds the gentlest way – cut into hills, filled in hollows, evenly graded, with banks at its sides. One selected edge: the road finds its way between its ends; several: it follows them.
road.name: Road

village.title: Villages
village.hint: Villages on the selected (or newest) terrain: on gentle ground away from water and what is built, a main street along the slope and side streets up and down it, houses beside them on plinths – connected by roads that find the gentlest way around the other villages.
village.nothing: No place for a village – fewer or smaller villages, or allow steeper ground.
village.name: Village {number}

steps.title: Building steps
steps.hint: What was built on this terrain, in order. Switch a step off, give it another seed or remove it – everything is built again on the terrain; so it is when the terrain’s settings change. Sculpting with the Terrain tool becomes a step of its own.
steps.failed: Built again: {count} steps. No longer possible: {steps}.
steps.none: This terrain has no building steps – build a river, road, city or villages on it first.
steps.unknown: There is no step {index} – the terrain has {count}.
steps.baseChanged: The terrain’s grid has a different size than when its first step was built – the steps cannot be built again.

errors.gridVersion: The Terrain plugin keeps its height grid in version {version}, this plugin knows version 1 – terrains made with it cannot be read or changed here.
